// Generated by `setu` — the development entry for the local diagnostics
// connector. The production entry (main.ts) never imports this file, and
// nothing in the production graph imports the diagnostics plugin: the
// composition below exists only here. Run it with `deno task dev`; the
// launcher supplies the session credentials through the process environment.

import { createApp } from './setu.config.ts';
import { createRuntimeServices } from '@setu-ts/runtime';
import { CAPABILITIES } from '@setu-ts/common';
import type { ILogger } from '@setu-ts/common';
import { DiagnosticsPlugin } from '@setu-ts/diagnostics-plugin';

const runtime = createRuntimeServices();

// The two variable names read below are a contract with the devtool launcher.
// Renaming or removing either one stops the devtool connecting, and the error
// will not say why. In a workspace the same names are read by scripts/dev.ts
// and granted to that runner's --allow-env list in the root deno.json —
// change those sites together.
const sessionId = Deno.env.get('SETU_DEVTOOL_SESSION_ID');
const rawSessionKey = Deno.env.get('SETU_DEVTOOL_SESSION_KEY');

if (sessionId === undefined || /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(sessionId) === false) {
  console.error(
    'setu devtool: SETU_DEVTOOL_SESSION_ID is absent or malformed (expected 32 lowercase' +
      ' hex characters, fresh per launch). The connector did not start.',
  );
  Deno.exit(1);
}
if (rawSessionKey === undefined || /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(rawSessionKey) === false) {
  console.error(
    'setu devtool: SETU_DEVTOOL_SESSION_KEY is absent or malformed (expected 32 bytes as' +
      ' 64 lowercase hex characters, fresh per launch). The connector did not start.',
  );
  Deno.exit(1);
}

const sessionKey = new Uint8Array(32);
for (let index = 0; index < 32; index++) {
  sessionKey[index] = Number.parseInt(rawSessionKey.slice(index * 2, index * 2 + 2), 16);
}

const diagnostics = DiagnosticsPlugin({
  enabled: true,
  port: 4919, // IPv4 loopback only; the listener refuses any other hostname
  sessionId,
  sessionKey,
  maxSessionLifetimeMs: 28_800_000,
});

const app = await createApp(undefined, {
  plugins: [diagnostics],
  diagnostics: {},
});

await app.start({ port: Number(runtime.env.PORT ?? '3000') });

// Graceful shutdown. Without this the process dies from the signal itself and
// `app.stop()` never runs, so in-flight requests are cut, the service never
// deregisters from discovery, and no database or broker disconnects.
//
// Portable across every runtime: no `Deno`, no `process`, no OS check. On
// Windows `onSignal` is absent and this registers nothing, which is correct —
// Windows has no SIGTERM to catch.
//
// The logger is resolved only if one is registered: a project scaffolded
// without LoggerPlugin still shuts down cleanly, it just reports nothing.
const logger = app.services.has(CAPABILITIES.LOGGER)
  ? app.services.get<ILogger>(CAPABILITIES.LOGGER)
  : undefined;

for (const signal of ['SIGTERM', 'SIGINT'] as const) {
  runtime.onSignal?.(signal, () => {
    // The .catch is not optional: a rejecting onShutdown hook makes stop()
    // reject, and an unhandled rejection replaces the reason with a trace.
    void app.stop()
      .then(() => runtime.exit(0))
      .catch((error: unknown) => {
        logger?.error('Graceful shutdown failed', { error });
        runtime.exit(1);
      });
  });
}
